en: Build a small electrical grid, keep the lights on through the day, and learn why it works. The grid is empty for now: levels arrive soon.
New to power systems · the grid explains itself
I know the basics · per-unit values, stricter limits
One step of the clock is one 15-minute block; 96 blocks make a day.
This is the empty province. Time moves in 15-minute blocks; press {tick} to move to the next one.
Real grids are balanced and settled every 15 minutes in many markets, so the game uses the same step.
Distances drawn compressed: 1 grid square = 4 km in the engine, 300 m on screen
